headline: How I work with you.
note: The same method specialist German SEO agencies use — as a freelancer, without the agency overhead.

steps.title: Monthly plan
steps.description: At the start of each month you receive a concrete plan of measures, with hours allocated per task.

steps.title: Approval
steps.description: No task starts without your sign-off. Full control over budget and priorities.

steps.title: Delivery & tracking
steps.description: Every measure is documented: URL, keyword, status, date.

steps.title: Reporting
steps.description: At month end: planned versus actual hours, results, and recommendations for the month ahead.
